JobSubmit.desc: Submit a long-running command as a background job: the HTTP call returns jobId immediately, then JobStatus carries the result. Params accept {interface, params} (same shape as a normal call) or {command}. The debugger must be stopped; the job runs at that stop point.

params.name: interface
params.desc: 要异步执行的接口名（与普通调用的 interface 相同）

params.name: params
params.desc: 该接口自身的参数对象

JobStatus.usage: 查询异步作业状态与结果
JobStatus.desc: Query a background job: state is queued/running/done/error/cancelled, elapsedMs is the wait time, and result holds the command response once finished.

params.name: jobId
params.desc: JobSubmit 返回的作业号（也接受直接传字符串）

JobList.usage: 列出异步作业（新的在前）
JobList.desc: List background jobs, newest first: params {limit} (default 20, max 200).

params.name: limit
params.desc: 返回条数上限，默认 20，最大 200

JobCancel.desc: Cancel a background job: a queued job is skipped before execution, a running job sets a cancel flag and finishes its current command; state then reflects the outcome.

LoadAllSymbols.usage: 一次性加载全部模块的符号
LoadAllSymbols.desc: Load symbols for every loaded module into one DbgHelp session; modules already loaded are skipped. Optional {module} limits it to a single module. Honors SetSymbolPath, _NT_SYMBOL_PATH or local search. pdbCount/exportOnlyCount/symlessCount split the loaded number by what DbgHelp actually got (PDB vs export table vs nothing).

SetSymbolPath.desc: Set the symbol search path (semicolon list, srv*<cache>*<server> supported). Without params it just returns the path in effect. --reset clears the custom path.

params.name: path
params.desc: 分号分隔的搜索路径，支持 srv*缓存*服务器

params.name: reset
params.desc: 清除自定义路径，回到环境变量/本地默认

SymbolPath.usage: 查询当前符号搜索路径
SymbolPath.desc: Query the symbol search path in effect: path, source (custom/env/default/local), srv availability and loaded module count.

ExceptionDirectory.usage: 读取 x64 异常目录（.pdata）
ExceptionDirectory.desc: List RUNTIME_FUNCTION entries of a module's exception directory: begin/end VA, unwind RVA, unwind flags, chained flag, handler RVA. x86 images usually have no .pdata.

params.name: address
params.desc: 按地址定位所属模块（与 module 二选一）

params.name: limit
params.desc: 返回条目上限，默认 200，最大 20000

UnwindInfo.desc: Decode UNWIND_INFO covering an address: prolog size, frame register/offset, unwind codes (PUSH_NONVOL / ALLOC_LARGE / ALLOC_SMALL / SET_FPREG / SAVE_*), handler RVA and chained info.
